1xxxx-court-testimony

Filename: 1xxxx-court-testimony
Date: Various, ranging from c1413 to 1686
Genre: Vernacular
Dialect: East and West Yiddish
Source: Salman Rubashov. 1929. Yidishe gvies-edes in di shayles-vetshuves fun anhoyb XVtn biz sof XVIItn yorhundert [Yiddish court testimony in the responsa literature of the early 15th to the late 17th century]. In Elye Tsherikover, ed., Historishe shriftn fun YIVO [YIVO historical papers], vol. 1. Warsaw: Kultur Liga. 115-196.
Notes: The court testimony comes from Rubashov 1929, 125-190. For convenience, the "page" references for the court testimony are Rubashov's item numbers, which have been supplemented to include (possibly estimated) date and dialect information based on Rubashov's discussion and text-internal evidence. Estimated dates are preceded by "c" (for "circa"). Dialects are indicated by "e" (East Yiddish) or "w" (West Yiddish) A trailing question mark after "e" or "w" indicates uncertainty. "x" indicates that the dialect cannot be established at all.
  • Item 12 is supplemented by two sentence tokens from Solomon A. Birnbaum. 1979. Yiddish: a survey and a grammar. Toronto: University of Toronto Press. 153, no. 9. "Zimlin of Ulm delivers a public apology before a (Jewish) court. (From the Responsa of Jacob Vail (Weil), No. 147, Venice, 1549, fol. 60v.)"
  • Item 61 is reprinted in Jechiel Bin-Nun. 1973. Jiddish und die deutschen Mundarten unter besonderer Berücksichtigung des ostgalizischen Jiddisch. Tübingen: Niemeyer. 45-46.
  • Item 126 is taken mostly from Solomon A. Birnbaum. 1979. Yiddish: a survey and a grammar. Toronto: University of Toronto Press. 171-172, no. 40. As abridged by Joel Serkes ('Bach') b. Samuel ha-Levi Jaffe, Bayis Khudosh, responsum no. 57. Frankfurt am Main, 1697, fol. 37r.
  • In the items from Birnbaum, his transliteration has been revised in accordance with YIVO guidelines.
Number of words: 17,579

1478w-letter-regensburg

Filename: 1478w-letter-regensburg
Date: 1478
Dialect: West Yiddish, Regensburg
Genre: Letter
Source: R. Straus. 1960. Urkunden und Aktenstücke zur Geschichte der Juden in Regensburg. Munich. P. 170, no. 502 and p. 456, no. 502. Reprinted in Solomon A. Birnbaum. 1979. Yiddish: a survey and a grammar. Toronto: University of Toronto Press. 155-156, no. 13.
Notes: Manuscript: Munich, Bayerisches Hauptstaatsarchiv, Gemeiners Nachlass, K 12/1. Oldest Yiddish letter of certain date. Normalized transliteration.
Number of words: 75

1620e-lev-tov-1-preface, 1620e-lev-tov-1

Filename: 1620e-lev-tov-1-preface, 1620e-lev-tov-1
Date: 1620
Dialect: East Yiddish
Genre: Prose (preface), verse (main text)
Source: Isaac ben Eliakum. Preface to Lev tov [The good heart]. Prague. Photocopy.
Catalog entries: C 264. DL 59. IDC 88. St 5344,1. Zi7 159.
Notes: Conflicting information on author: either from Poznan (C, Zi7) or Prague (Erika Timm, pers. comm.). Muser literature.
Number of words: 1,482 + 3,427
